7595.abstract_ko: 기후변화에 대응하기 위한 탄소배출 규제가 세계적으로 강화되면서 한국도 기후변화협약의 당사국으로서 강력한 이행을 권고 받고 있다. 특히 한국은 환경규제 강화에 대한 정부와 산업계, 국민의 이해관계가 복잡하므로 환경규제가 경제성장과 전력소비량, 이산화탄소 배출량 감축 등에 미치는 영향에 관한 연구는 매우 중요하다. 이에 본 논문은 한국에서 환경규제와 경제성장, 전력소비량, 이산화탄소 배출량 간의 인과관계를 실증분석하였다. 이를 위해 1987 ～ 2014년 동안의 시계열 자료를 바탕으로 단위근 검정, 공적분 검정, 벡터오차수정모형(VECM)을 통한 인과성 검정을 실시하였다. 환경 규제를 중심으로 경제성장, 전력소비량, 이산화탄소 배출량 간 인과관계 분석 결과를 살펴보면, 환경규제는 경제성장에 영향을 주지 못하고 있으나, 전력소비량과 이산화탄소 배출량에 양방향의 인과관계를 보이는 것으로 나타났다. 즉, 우리나라의 환경규제는 이산화탄소 배출 저감을 중심으로 환경규제가 나타나고, 이산화탄소 배출 비중이 높은 전력부문으로 환경오염방지투자가 이뤄지고 있는 것으로 판단된다. 그러나 이러한 투자가 아직 경제성장의 동력으로는 이어지지 못하고 있는 것으로 이해할 수 있다. 이러한 분석결과는 환경규제가 이산화탄소 배출량 감축을 위한 기술혁신과 생산성 향상을 유발하여 경제성장에 기여할 수 있도록 하는 정책개발이 필요하다는 정책적 시사점을 제시한다. 또한 국제 탄소배출 규제가 본격적으로 실행될 경우, 환경규제가 혁신을 통한 경제성장, 전력소비량에 따른 전원구성의 변화와 이산화탄소 배출량의 감축 등에 관련된 정책 간에 충돌을 일으키지 않고 시너지 효과를 창출하도록 하는 세심한 정책구상는 점을 시사한다.
7595.abstract_en: The rapid climate change is strengthening carbon emissions regulations internationally. Korea is  strongly pressed to accept the obligation to reduce greenhouse gases as one of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change. This article analyzed the Granger causalities among environmental regulation, economic growth, electricity consumption, and CO2 emission in Korea, using unit root test, cointegration test, and vector error correction model. As the results, environmental regulation in Korea has been affected by economic growth, electricity consumption, and CO2 emission, while not in the opposite direction. Economic growth has unidirectionally affected electricity consumption, CO2 emission. and environment regulation. Electricity consumption has been affected by economic growth, CO2 emission, and environmental regulation. Only CO2 emission has shown the bidirectional causalities among economic growth, electricity consumption, and environmental regulation. The policy implications will be as follows: ① environmental regulation should induce sustainable growth through encouraging technological innovation relating to CO2 reduction and productivity enhancement. ② Responding to the international CO2 reduction regulation, the synthetic policy initiatives will be considered to make synergy effect among policies relating to economic growth & electricity consumption.

7596.title_ko: 한국 R&D수행 환경기업의 자원투입이 경영성과에 미치는 영향: 혁신의 매개효과를 중심으로
7596.title_en: The Effects of Resource Inputs on Business Performances in Korean Environmental Companies Conducting R&D : Focusing on the Mediating Effect of Innovation
7596.author: 김근우
7596.abstract_en: This article analyzed the direct impact of resource inputs on business performances of Korean environmental companies conducting R&D, and the mediation effects of product-, process-, organization-, & marketing-innovations between resource inputs and business performances. We conducted the mediation analysis using SPSS and Process Macro, based on a survey data from the Korean environmental companies. The article found that ① resource inputs have directly had a positive impact on business performances, and ② innovations have mediated them. ③ But among 4 types of innovations, the only mediation effect of organization-innovation has been verified, and the others have not appeared. Considering the above results, the following policy implications can be suggested. ① It is necessary to reinforce related policies so that companies can improve business performances through innovation. ② The government needs to carry out the prudent supporting policies so that innovations in product, process, and marketing can lead to business performances. This article has the limitation of using the survey data, and needs further researches on the sectoral system of innovation for Korean environmental industry.

7600.title_ko: FACTS를 이용한 교류전기철도 병렬급전에 관한 연구
7600.title_en: A Study on the Parallel Feeding AC Traction Power Supply Systems using FACTS
7600.author: 이병복
7600.abstract_en: Parallel-feeding operation of AC traction power supply system has advantages of extending power supply section and increasing power supply capacity by reducing voltage drop and peak demand caused by train operation load. But the parallel-feeding operation is strictly restricted because of the circulating power flow induced from the phase difference between substations, and the power supply capacity is limited because of the unbalanced substation load depending on train load distribution which can be changed by train operation along railway track. This paper suggests Thyristor-controlled Phase Angle Regulator(TCPAR) to reduce the circulating power flow and the unbalanced substation load which depend on the phase difference and the train load distribution, and provides a feasibility study. A dedicated control model of TCPAR is also provided which uses substation power supplies as input to control the circulating power flow and the unbalanced substation load depending on the phase difference and the train load distribution. Simulation studies using PSCAD/EMTDC shows the proposed TCPAR control model can reduce the circulating power flow as well as the unbalanced substation load depending on the phase difference and the train load distribution. It is expected that the proposed TCPAR can extend the parallel-feeding operation of AC traction power system and increase the power supply capacity

7617.title_en: A Study on the Improvement of Grain Labeling Design
7617.author: 양호승
7617.abstract_ko:
우리국민이 섭취하는 곡류 중 쌀은 64% 이상의 비중을 차지하며, 수입으로 의존하는 다른 식량작물과는 달리 86.1%의 자급률로 의존하고 있다. 쌀의 재배면적은 국내 전체 경작지 면적의 54%를 차지하며, 농가소득의 49.2%가 쌀농사로부터 나온다. 이렇듯 쌀은 우리민족의 주 생활에너지원이며, 농촌경제의 주요 원천이다. 이러한 이유로 정부는 쌀의 품질 향상과 소비자 알권리 보장을 위하여 양곡표시사항을 실시하고 있다. 그러나 양곡표시사항 인지도 설문조사결과 양곡표시사항을 보지 않는다는 소비자가 많고 양곡표시사항을 보는 경우에도 이해하기 어려운 것으로 나타나고 있으며 소비자가 알고자 하는 정보가 전달되지 않는 등 양곡표시사항은 소비자의 주목을 받지 못하고 있는 실정이다. 이러한 문제점을 파악하기 위하여 양곡관리법 양곡표시사항 시행규칙의 내용을 분석하였고 이것이 시판되고 있는 쌀 포장지에는 어떻게 적용되고 있는지 조사하였다. 조사결과 현행 양곡표시사항은 첫째, 제품마다 일관성이 없는 형태와 방식으로 적용되어 있으며, 둘째, 소비자가 쉽고 정확하게 인지할 수 있는 정보전달 체계가 부족하고, 셋째, 관리자 관점의 정보 중심이라는 점을 파악할 수 있었다. 이러한 문제점들을 해결하기 위하여 셰넌과 위버의 선형 모델(Shannon's and Weaver's Model)을 토대로 양곡표시사항 커뮤니케이션 모델을 설정하고 소비자의 신념변화를 위하여 데이비스(1989)의 기술수용모델(Technology Acceptance Model)을 접목하였다. 양곡표시사항의 정보전달이 쉽고 편리하다고 지각하는 정도의 지각된 용이성(perceived ease of use)은 기술적 문제로서 양곡표시사항 일괄표시의 크기, 위치, 시각적 흐름, 색, 표시 문자, 시각화, 인쇄방식으로 세분화하였다. 양곡표시사항이 양곡정보습득에 도움이 된다고 설정한 지각된 유용성(perceived usefulness)은 의미론적 문제와 효과적 문제로서 명칭의 일관성, 쉬운 용어, 정보의 위계로 세분화하였다. 정보전달력을 높이기 위하여 존 마에다(John Maeda)의 SLIP 이론을 사용하여 양곡표시사항의 정보표시요소를 중요정보, 일반정보, 임의표시가 가능한 정보로 분류하였다. 분류된 정보는 원칙에 따라 양곡표시사항의 정보표시 기준을 설정하고 이에 따른 양곡표시사항의 디자인체계를 제안하였다. 
본 연구의 목적은 쌀의 양곡표시사항을 소비자관점으로 개선하여 소비자에게 쌀에 대한 정보를 보다 알기 쉽고 유용하게 전달할 수 있는 기반을 마련하는 데에 있다. 이를 통하여 소비자에게 쌀에 대한 긍정적 사고와 올바른 쌀 소비문화 조성에 도움이 될 수 있을 것으로 기대한다. 또한 본 연구에서 제시한 쌀의 양곡표시사항 디자인이 우리나라 식품 정보체계의 디자인 개발 시 하나의 지침이 될 수 있기를 바란다.
7617.abstract_en: In Korea, rice accounts for over 64 percent of the total grain consumed, and unlike other food crops that depend on imports, Korea is 86.1 percent self-sufficient in rice.  The cultivation area of rice takes 54 percent of the country's total arable land area, and 49.2 percent of farming income comes from rice. As described, rice plays a role as the main energy for Korean people, and a driving force of rural economy.  For this reason, the government is enforcing a grain labelling system to improve the quality of Korean rice and to guarantee consumers’ rights to know.  However, the survey results show that grain labels do not receive the attention of consumers due to the lack of consumers’ interest in the labels and the failure of information delivery.  To understand these issues, the contents of the grain labelling instruction in the Grain Management Act were analyzed and the application method of this system to rice packages on the market was investigated. On top of that, the consumer recognition of the grain labelling instruction was surveyed.  The survey results showed that (1) the current grain labelling has been applied in an inconsistent form and manner by product, (2) there is a lack of an information delivery system for easy and accurate recognition, and (3) the information is indicated from the managers’ perspective.  In order to resolve these problems, this study applies the Technology Acceptance Model by Davis (1989) for a shift in consumer beliefs and set the communication model for grain Labeling based on the Shannon's and Weaver's Model.  The perceived ease of use (the degree of convenience and easy information delivery) of grain Labeling is broken down to size, location, visual flow, color, displayed characters, visualization, and printing method of the uniform displays of grain Labeling as technical issues.  The perceived usefulness (helpfulness for information acquisition), is broken down into consistency of name, comprehensive terms, and use of hierarchical information as the issues of effectiveness and semantics.  In order to enhance information delivery, this study used the SLIP theory by John Maeda to classify the information given by grain Labeling into important information, general information, and temporary information.  Information standards were set for these classified information of grain Labeling according to the principles to suggest a design system for grain Labeling.  This study aims to improve the rice labelling instruction from a consumer's point of view for easy and useful information delivery.  And the research may contribute to positive consumer recognition about rice and the right culture for rice consumption.  Also, the design of the grain Labeling for rice suggested in this study can be a guideline for design development of the food information systems in South Korea.

7627.title_ko: 도자장신구 가치 확대 연구 : Holbrook의 소비가치 이론을 바탕으로 분석
7627.title_en: A study on value expansion of ceramic jewelry : analysis base on Holbrook's consumer values theory
7627.author: 김지윤
7627.abstract_en: In this study, in order to overcome the poor perception of value of the porcelain jewellery market and increase consumer value, we will apply the Meta-analysis Research Act to examine the types of past period-occurring ornaments through the history of jewellery and the new trend of modern jewellery. Based on this historical nature, we interpret the essential purity of the soil material itself and present the possibility of artistic value as a ceramic jewelry material through the grafting of the special texture and characteristics of soil with the Haptic theory. Based on this theoretical basis, it is necessary to develop a new brand to increase the value of the ceramic ornaments field in line with the cultural trends demanded by the times.   To this end, based on the theory of consumption value type theory presented by Holbrook (1999) and the Shelth’s theory (1991) of consumption value such as Holbrook, the concept and characteristics of masstige were identified based on the social value, pleasure value and emotional value, and the study of brand name and brand image were conducted for the development of the Masstige brand, and the effectiveness and affordability of the Masstige brand was conducted on the effect of purchasing satisfaction. By substituting brand name and brand image as independent variables for the development of mastic brand, by substituting efficiency and causality cost for internal variables, and by selecting satisfaction and willingness to purchase affected by consumption value as dependent variables, the variables affected by the mastic brand ultimately affect consumer satisfaction and purchasing attitude, the company seeks to propose the expansion of final ceramic brand value.   Based on Holbrook's consumer theory, the results of the analysis of ceramic ornaments were divided into the superior functional value of ceramic materials, emotional value, social value and altruistic aspect value. Based on this, the government has established hypotheses such as research issues 1.2 and 3 to overcome the limitations of activating the Mastizi brand in the ceramic jewelry sector.   Based on the theories of Sheth (1991), which presented the theory of consumption value such as Holbrook, the study design based on the common theory, established each measurement item for brand reputation, brand image, efficiency, causality ratio, satisfaction, and intent to purchase, focusing on emotional value, pleasure value, and social value.    Research and analysis has shown that brand name, which is an independent variable of the Masstige brand, and brand image greatly affect the efficiency and causality cost of consumption, and also the satisfaction and willingness of consumers who are subordinate variables.   Based on these results, we are going to present a new popular brand of high-end ceramic ornaments by combining the advantages of ceramic materials alone and the emotional factors of craft with new technology.

7631.title_ko: 나노 다이아몬드 입자가 첨가된 윤활유의 금속재에 대한 마찰 및 마모거동
7631.title_en: Wear and friction behavior of lubricants with nano-diamond particles on metallic materials
7631.author: 봉필준
7631.abstract_en: Ball-to-disc wear testing experiments were conducted in order to investigate wear and friction characteristics of commercial diesel engines oil (5W-40) with adding 0, 0.005, 0.0075, 0.01, 0.0125, 0.0175, 0.0175, 0.0175, 0.0125, 0.022, 0.025, 0.03 wt.% ND particles. The upper specimen was 4 mm diameter SUJ-2 high carbon chromium steel ball. The lower specimens are aging-treated aluminum Al-7075 alloy, FCD500 cast iron, and SK3 carbon tool steel. Wear test conditions of contact force and sliding distance for the Al-7075, FCD500, and SK3 are 10N-500m, 20N-1km and 35N-24km, respectively. The effects of ND addition were considered through observation of wear rate, coefficient of friction, and surface illumination of the disc test specimen. The results of the experiment are as follows: For the Al-7075 alloys and FCD500 cast iron discs with regard to wear rate, the wear rate of oil with ND was increased rapidly compared to the base oil with ND added. This reason is judged to increase wear on the disk specimen as ND particles are trapped on the bumpy surface of the test specimen's contact area, serving as abrasive agents. However, it was found that SK3 carbon tool steels had the best lubricant by adding 0.015% of ND and reduced by more than 30% compared to non-added oil. This is judged that ND particles played a role of micro-ball bearing on wear contacting surfaces. Regarding the average friction coefficient, it was confirmed that, for both FCD500 cast iron and SK3 tool steel discs, the lubrication oil without ND exhibited the lowest and there was almost proportional relationship between the average friction coefficient and wear rate. However, for the aluminium Al-7075 alloys, the oil with an ND of 0.0075% exhibited the lowest friction coefficient value. After the wear test, the average depth and wear rate of the contact surfaces of the disc specimen were all correlated in all three types of materials. In case of the aluminum al-7075 alloy, FCD500 cast iron steel and SK3 tool steel, lubricants with 0%, 0% and 0.015% ND showd the smallest average depth value. The wear test results for 10 types of lubricants showed that the best lubricants for the aluminium Al-7075 alloys and FCD500 iron found to be the oil without ND in terms of friction and wear characteristics. And, the best lubricant for SK3 carbon tool steel discs was found to be the lubricant with added 0.015% ND in terms of wear characteristics. This study was conducted at one fixed contact pressure and slide speed and distance, and these results are limited to one-on-one application of ND to lubricating oils. Therefore, it needs further investigate the effects of ND particles additions under various contact loads, sliding speeds, oil temperatures and sliding distances.

In this way, it will be assured that the emergent maintenance required due to the economic life of infrastructure, planning and programming will be made, new routes or connections will be determined when necessary.

7651.title_en: Improvement of Business Process by Reengineering in Railway Operation Organization
7651.author: 주마크하노바 마루엣
7651.abstract_en:
The Business Process Reengineering (BPR) method is defined by Hammer and Champy as “the fundamental reconsideration and radical redesign of organizational processes, in order to achieve drastic improvement of current performance in cost, service and speed” [1]. Nowadays many organizations have undertaken business process reengineering initiatives with the aim of improving organizational performance. These initiatives inevitably involve redesign of organization and alterations within the business processes. Reengineering leads to an improvement in the management system of organization, and not only individual business processes. Job design, organizational structures, improving working conditions and technology, and culture – each item connected with the process should be integrated with process. Ways to reengineer the traffic safety provision business process in a railway company by integrating many types of changes are considered in this thesis: definition of high responsibility of top management, the method of management in all level of management, installation of KPI, interaction between departments, the safety culture and building an organizational structure. The relevance of this thesis is that organizations now are forced to work constantly on improving their operation process because of the continually growing competitive environment and work on organization efficiency (direct and indirect benefits), as well as ensuring traffic safety (ETS) is considered an important issue in the transport area.
This research work on improving BP in ensuring traffic safety is based on the processes in the national company of the Republic of Kazakhstan – “Kazakhstan Temir Zholy” (Kazakhstan Railways, Company). The case study demonstrates the usefulness of the methodology for analyzing and understanding the Company, as well as the significant improvements in the performance of the Company's traffic safety process that can be achieved by changing the “safety culture” by installing the KPI. In addition, the BPR methodology has been found to be helpful in reducing incidents in the Kazakhstan railway.

7658.title_ko: 셀프피어싱 리베팅한 마그네슘 합금 이종재료 접합부의 피로강도 평가 : Fatigue Strength Evaluation of Self-Piercing Riveted Joints  in Dissimilar Metal Sheets of Magnesium Alloy
7658.title_en: Fatigue Strength Evaluation of Self-Piercing Riveted Joints  in Dissimilar Metal Sheets of Magnesium Alloy
7658.author: 강세형
7658.abstract_ko: 마그네슘 합금은 다른 구조용 재료에 비하여 비강도 및 비강성이 우수하며, 우수한 진동 감쇠 능력과 충격 흡수성, 전자파 차폐특성성능을 지니고 있다. 이러한 특성으로 인하여 차체에 적용시 경량화 및 승차감 향상이 동시에 가능하여 차체 판넬 등에 적용이 증가되고 있는 추세이다. 기존의 철강재 판재에 적용되는 점용접의 경우 철강재가 아닌 다른 이종재를 접합시 용융점 및 전기저항 등의 차이로 접합이 거의 불가능하다. 따라서, 차체 접합에 대한 점용접의 대안으로 셀프 피어싱 리베팅 (self-piercing riveting, SPR) 방식이 적용되고 있다. 본 연구에서는 AZ31 마그네슘 합금 판재와 냉간압연강판재(SPCC), 알루미늄 합금 판재 (Al-5052)를 SPR 방식으로 접합한 접합부의 정적강도와 피로강도를 평가하고자 한다. 이를 위하여 시험편의 형상을 인장-전단 및 십자형 시험편으로 제작하여 다양한 하중각도에서 SPR 접합부의 정적강도 및 피로강도를 평가하였다. 시험편의 조합을 상판 마그네슘 AZ31-하판 냉간압연강판 SPCC (Upper Magnesium Sheet-Lower Steel Sheet, U.M-L.S으로 명명)으로 제작하였다. 또한, 상판 마그네슘 AZ31-하판 알루미늄 합금 Al-5052 (Upper Magnesium Sheet-Lower Aluminum Sheet, U.M-L.A으로 명명)로 제작하였다. SPR 접합에 있어 가장 우수한 접합강도를 갖는 리벳 펀치하중을 확인한 결과 U.M-L.S, U.M-L.A는 각각 35 kN, 32 kN으로 결정하여, 이 하중으로 이들 시험편을 제작하였다. U.M-L.S SPR접합부 시험편 대하여 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o 에서 정적시험 결과 정적강도는 상판의 압연방향과 하중방향이 수직인 시험편의 경우 각각 3,764 N, 2,009 N, 1,857 N으로 나타나, 하중각도가 증가하면서 강도가 저하되었다. 또한, 상판의 압연방향과 하중 방향이 평행하거나 수직방향인 시험편의 강도가 유사한 값을 나타내었다. U.M-L.A SPR 접합부 시험편 대해 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o 에서 정적시험 결과 정적강도는 각각 3,315 N, 1,955 N, 1,644 N으로 나타나, U.M-L.S SPR조합 시험편보다 정적강도는 다소 낮은 것으로 나타났다. 수명이 106 cycles를 피로한도로 가정하여, U.M-L.S SPR 접합부 시험편의 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o에서 피로한도는 각각 824 N, 257 N, 168 N으로 나타났다. 이는 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o에서의 피로비(= 피로한도/정적강도)는 각각 22%, 13%, 9%에 해당한다. U.M-L.A SPR접합부 시험편의 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o에서 피로한도는 각각 847 N, 224 N, 149 N으로 나타났다. 이는 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o에서의 피로비는 각각 26%, 11%, 9%에 해당한다. 이와 같이, 하중 각도별 U.M-L.S의 피로비와 다소 유사한 것으로 나타났다. 특히, 0o의 경우 피로한도가 U.M-L.S 시험편 보다 높다는 것은 U.M-L.S의 경우 접촉 상대재인 SPCC와의 경도 차이로 마그네슘 상판이 미동마멸 (fretting)에 의한 균열발생에 취약함으로 발생된 것으로 판단된다. U.M-L.S SPR 접합부 시험편의 피로에 의한 접합부의 파단은 세 가지 하중각도 모두 균열이 리벳 shank와 상판과 하판이 접촉하는 삼중점에서 발생하여 상판의 두께 방향으로 전파되어 최종적으로 리벳을 관통하여 파단이 발생하였다. 그러나, U.M-L.A SPR 접합부 시험편의 경우 하중 각도에 따라 서로 다른 위치에서 피로균열이 발생하여 파단된 것으로 확인되었다. U.M-L.S SPR 시험편의 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o에 대한 피로수명을 von-Mises 응력, 최대주응력, 최대주변형률, 등가응력확대계수를 적용하여 평가한 결과 최대주응력이 피로수명을 가장 적절히 평가하였다. 또한, U.M-L.A SPR 접합부 시험편의 경우, 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o에 대한 피로수명을 von-Mises 응력, 최대주응력, 최대주변형률, 등가응력확대계수를 적용하여 평가한 결과 등가응력확대계수가 피로수명을 가장 적절히 평가가 가능하다. U.M-L.S 및 U.M-L.A SPR 시험편의 다양한 하중 상태에서의 피로수명과 등가응력확대계수와의 상관관계식을 이용하여 두 종류의 시험편의 피로수명을 3배의 오차 범위내에서 적절하게 수명을 예측하는 것을 확인하였다. 이와 같은 사실은 상판의 마그네슘 AZ31의 피로에 대한 저항도가 두 종류의 시험편 피로수명을 주도하고 있음을 나타내고 있다.
7658.abstract_en: Magnesium alloys have high-specific-strength and rigidity materials compared to other structural metal alloys. And, they have excellent vibration damping capacity and shock absorbability. Due to these characteristics, the light weight and ride quality can be achieved when the magnesium alloys are applied to the vehicle body. Therefore, their application to vehicle body is increasing. In the case of conventional spot-welding technique, which is being applied to steel sheet joining, it is almost impossible to join them due to differences in melting points and electrical resistance when joining non-ferrous material sheets. Therefore, SPR joining method has become a promising alternative method for non-ferrous material sheet joining. In this study, the static and fatigue strengths of the SPR joints of AZ31 magnesium alloy sheets, cold-rolled steel (SPCC) sheets and Al-5052 aluminium alloy sheets are to be evaluated. For this purpose, the tensile-shear and cross-shaped specimens were used to evaluate the strength of the SPR joints at various load angles. The combination of upper magnesium sheet - lower steel sheet specimen is designated U.M-L.S. Another combination of upper magnesium sheet - lower aluminum Al-5052 alloy sheet is designated  U.M-L.A. The riveting punch load with the highest joint strength in SPR joining was identified and the punching loads of U.M-L.S and U.M-L.A combination were found to be 35 kN and 32 kN, respectively. The static strengths of U.M-L.S SPR joints of a upper sheet coupon with transverse direction to the rolling  direction with respect to the loading directions at 0o, 45o, and 90o loading angles were 3,764 N, 2,009 N, and 1,857 N, respectively. The reduction in the strength was due to increased load angle. Static strengths at 0o, 45o, and 90o loading angles for U.M-L.A SPR joints were shown to be 3,315 N, 1,955 N, and 1,644 N respectively, indicating that the strengths were somewhat lower static strength than those of the U.M-L.S SPR specimens. The load amplitudes corresponding to the fatigue limit of U.M-L.S specimens, based on a 106 cycle lifetime, were 824 N, 257 N, and 168 N for the loading angles of 0°, 45° and 90°, respectively. The fatigue ratios (= fatigue limit/static strength) of the U.M-L.S specimens at load angles of 0, 45°and 90°are equivalent to 22%, 13% and 9%, respectively. The fatigue limits of the U.M-L.A SPR specimens at the load angles of 0°, 45° and 90°, were found to be 847 N, 224 N and 149 N, respectively. The fatigue ratios at loading angles of 0°, 45°and 90°are 26%, 11%, and 9%, respectively. Therefore, it was shown that the fatigue ratios of U.M-L.S at three loading angles are somewhat similar. In particular, it is judged that the fatigue limit is higher than the U.M-L.S specimen for the loading angel of 0°. This behavior is due to the difference in hardness of SPCC sheet, which is facing material for U.M-L.S specimen. The magnesium sheet is vulnerable to crack-initiation caused by fretting. A fatigue crack initiated a few millimeters from the center of the rivet, at the point where the upper and lower sheets were in contact. It then propagated through the upper sheet thickness, while simultaneously propagating laterally toward the direction of the load. The fatigue lifetimes of the U.M-L.S specimen at loading angles of 0°, 45°and 90°were evaluated by applying von-Mises stress, the maximum principal stress, the maximum principal strain and the equivalent stress intensity factor. It was found that the maximum principal stress evaluates appropriately the fatigue lifetimes. For the U.M-L.A  specimens, the stress intensity factor is found to be most appropriate for the fatigue lifetimes of the specimens. A correlation between fatigue lifetime and the stress intensity factor of U.M-L.S and U.M-L.A specimens under various loading conditions was used to ensure that the fatigue lifetimes of the two types of specimens were properly predicted within a factor three. This suggests that the resistance of magnesium AZ31 to fatigue cracking in the upper sheet dominates the fatigue lifetimes of two types specimens

7659.title_ko: SAC125 무연 솔더 접합부의 열 피로 수명 해석
7659.title_en: SAC125 무연 솔더 접합부의 열 피로 수명 해석
7659.author: 문정준
7659.abstract_ko: Chip과 PCB를 연결하는 솔더 연결부는 고온 환경에서 주로 사용되며 다양한 Chip과 패키지 부품의 CTE(Coefficient of thermal expansion)의 차이로 인하여 고온의 열 충격(Thermal shock) 조건에 노출되어 솔더 연결부의 균열 발생으로 인하여 전자제품에 대한 신뢰성 확보가 필요하다. 특히, 솔더 연결부(Solder joint)의 열 피로에 대한 수명평가는 신뢰성 확보에 대단히 중요하다. 본 연구에서는 소형 전자제품의 열 충격에 의한 솔더 연결부의 열 피로 수명을 평가하기 위하여 실제 열 피로 사이클 시험을 수행한 부품의 단면을 관찰하였고, PCB와 연결된 위치에서 솔더 볼의 균열을 확인하였다. 또한, 실장된 Sn1.2Ag0.5Cu(SAC125) 솔더 볼의 기계적 물성치를 평가하기 위하여 나노인덴테이션 시험을 통해 솔더 볼의 기계적 물성 특성을 평가하였다. 나노인덴터의 압입 간 거리를 압입 크기의 약 7배 정도로 하였고, 국부 소성 변형에 영향이 없다고 판단될 만큼의 거리를 확보한 결과 SAC125의 탄성계수는 약 54.2GPa로 나타났다. 도면에 명시된 솔더 볼의 크기와 리플로우 공정 이후의 솔더 볼에 대한 형상 차이를 확인하기 위해 실제 솔더 볼의 단면 확인 및 크기를 측정하였다. 측정 결과 Chip과 연결된 솔더 볼의 직경과 PCB에 연결된 솔더 볼의 직경의 차이를 확인할 수 있었으며, 솔더 볼의 최대 직경과 볼 피치(Pitch)는 도면 정보와 일치함을 확인하였다. 이 정보를 이용하여 해석 모델을 구성할 수 있었다. 구조-열 연성 해석을 통해 솔더 볼의 수명을 예측하기 위해 열(thermal) 사이클 간 변화율을 확인하여 2 사이클의 경계조건으로 줄여 해석 시간을 단축시킬 수 있었다. 솔더 볼의 수명 예측을 위한 여러 가지 방법 중 크리프 특성을 고려한 Syed의 실험식과 Schuberts의 실험식을 비교하였다. 해석에서 계산된 크리프 변형률 에너지 밀도를 이용하여 각 실험식에 대입한 결과 실제 균열 등으로 파손이 발생한 700~800 사이클의 시료 수명은 Schuberts의 실험식을 적용한 686 사이클의 수명 결과가 근접한 것으로 나타났다. Syed의 실험식을 이용한 경우 약 1032 사이클로 다소 높게 나타났다. 또한, 전자 장치의 신뢰성 데이터 분석에 가장 널리 사용되는 와이블 분포를 생성하기 위하여 형상 모수(β)를 4로 가정하였을 경우 솔더 볼의 고장 확률은 약 500 사이클에서 시험제품의 20%의 고장 확률을 나타냈고, 약 2000 사이클에서는 100% 시험제품의 솔더에서 균열이 발생하여 고장이 발생할 것으로 예측되었다.
7659.abstract_en: The solder connection between the chip and the PCB is mainly used in high temperature environment and due to the difference in the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) of various chips and package components, the solder connection is exposed to high temperature thermal shock conditions and causes cracks in the solder connection. Therefore, it is necessary to secure reliability for electronic products. In particular, the life assessment of thermal fatigue of solder joints is very important for ensuring reliability. In this study, in order to evaluate the thermal fatigue life of solder joints due to thermal shock of small electronics, the cross-sections of the parts subjected to the actual thermal fatigue cycle test were observed, and the solder balls were cracked at the positions connected to the PCB. In addition, in order to evaluate the mechanical properties of the mounted Sn1.2Ag0.5Cu (SAC125) solder ball, the mechanical properties of the solder ball were evaluated through the nanoindentation test. The distance between the indentations of the nanoindenter was about 7 times the indentation size, and the elastic modulus of SAC125 was about 54.2GPa. In order to confirm the difference in the size of the solder balls and the shape of the solder balls after the reflow process, the cross-sectional view and the size of the actual solder balls were measured. As a result of the measurement, the difference between the diameter of the solder ball connected to the chip and the diameter of the solder ball connected to the PCB was confirmed, and the maximum diameter of the solder ball and pitch were consistent with the drawing information. This information could be used to construct an analytical model. The structure-thermal coupled analysis reduced the analysis time by checking the thermal cycle change rate to predict the life cycle of the solder ball and reducing it to the boundary condition of 2 cycles. Among the various methods for estimating the lifetime of solder balls, the lifetime equation of Syed and the Schuberts equation considering creep characteristics are compared. Using the creep strain energy density calculated in the analysis, the lifespan of 700 to 800 cycles, which occurred actual cracking, was close to that of 686 cycles using Schuberts' life formula. In the case of Syed's life formula, it was found to be somewhat higher at about 1032 cycles. In addition, if the shape parameter (β) is assumed to be 4 to generate the most widely used weibull distribution for analyzing the reliability data of the electronic device, the probability of failure of the solder ball shows a probability of failure of 20% of the test product at about 500 cycles. At about 2000 cycles, it was predicted that a failure would occur due to cracking in the solder of the 100% test product.

7660.title_ko: 셀프피어싱 리베팅한 알루미늄 합금 이종재료 접합부의 피로강도 평가
7660.title_en: Fatigue Strength Evaluation of Self-Piercing Riveted Joints in Dissimilar Metal Sheets of an Aluminum Alloy
7660.author: 최덕호

7661.title_ko: 잔류응력을 고려한 마그네슘-알루미늄 판재 셀프 피어싱 리벳 접합부의 피로강도
7661.title_en: Fatigue Strength of Self-Piercing Riveted Magnesium-Aluminum Joint Considering Residual Stresses
7661.author: 한정진
7661.abstract_ko: 차체 접합에 사용되는 접합방법에는 점용접과 같은 방법이 가장 널리 사용되고 있다. 그 중 경량화재료를 이용한 차체 접합에는 셀프 피어싱 리베팅(self-piercing rivet, SPR)이 가장 접합하다고 많은 연구에서 발표하였으며, SPR 접합부의 정적강도 및 피로강도에 대해 많은 연구가 진행 중이다. 본 연구에서는 SPR 접합과정에서 접합부에 발생하는 가공경화와 잔류응력이 SPR 접합부의 피로강도에 영향을 미친다고 판단하여 잔류응력을 고려한 상태에서의 피로강도를 평가하고자 한다. 본 연구에서는 상판(AZ31), 하판(Al5052)을 리벳(S35C)을 이용해 시험편을 제작하였고, 다양한 펀치하중에 대해 정적강도를 평가하여 최적펀치하중을 32 kN으로 평가하였다. SPR 시험편에 비파괴 잔류응력 측정법 중 하나인 X선 회절분석법을 이용해 SPR접합단면에 대해 2개의 측정지점에 각각 -110.3±23.4MPa, -126.6±28.5MPa로 압축 잔류응력을 확인하였다. 또한, ABAQUS explicit으로 성형해석을 수행하여 동일한 지점에서 σθ의 잔류응력이 -126.5MPa, -152.9MPa으로 확인하였으며 실제 시험편과 해석모델에서의 잔류응력의 오차는 각각 12.8%, 17.2%로 확인하였다. SPR 접합과정에서 판재의 가공경화를 확인하기 위해 성형해석 결과에서 판재의 변형률과 비커스 경도 값을 비교한 결과 측정지점에서 상관성 보였으며, SPR 접합과정에서 가공경화가 발생한 것으로 판단된다. 또한, 정적강도와 피로강도를 하중각도 0o, 45o, 90o로 구분하여 각각 구분하여 만능시험기로 정적강도와 하중진폭에 대한 접합부의 피로수명을 평가하였다. 정적강도의 경우 하중각도가 작을 때 최대정적강도가 커졌지만, 짧은 변위에도 접합부에 분리가 발생하였다. 피로강도 평가는 다양한 하중진폭에 대해 구조해석을 수행하여 SPR 접합부에 발생하는 응력을 확인하여 S-N선도로 평가하였다. 구조해석은 실제단면을 고려한 모델 / 성형해석 후 잔류응력을 고려한 모델 / 성형해석 후 잔류응력을 고려하지 않은 모델로 3가지의 해석모델을 가지고 von-Mises 응력, 최대주응력, SWT 매개변수로 응력진폭과 피로수명 사이의 상관관계를 확인했다. 그 중 성형해석 후 잔류응력을 고려한 구조해석 모델에 대해 하중진폭을 최대주응력으로 평가했을 때 데이터의 분산이 적게 나타나 응력진폭에 대해 피로수명을 적절히 평가할 수 있다고 판단된다. 최대주응력과 반복수의 관계는 σ1=472.7·Nf-0.13으로 나타났다.
7661.abstract_en:
SPR (self-piercing rivet) joining is one of the vehicle body joining methods for lightweight materials. Work hardening of the sheets and residual stresses of the joints that occur during the SPR process affect the strength of the SPR joints. In this study, fatigue strength of the joint was evaluated in the condition where residual stress is taken into account. The SPR joint of AZ31 magnesium alloy as the upper sheet and aluminum Al5052 alloy sheet as the lower sheet was prepared. The optimum punch load of 32kN was determined after evaluating the static strength of tensile-shear specimen with various punch loads. All the static and fatigue specimens were produced with the optimum punch load. Two kinds of residual stress measurement techniques were adopted. One method is XRD (x-ray diffraction) method as a non-destructive method. The compressive residual stresses of the SPR joint were measured as -110.3±23.4MPa and -126.6±28.5MPa for the two measuring points using the high resolution 2-dimensional X-ray diffraction. The other method is FEM analysis. The residual stresses of σθ were verified as -126.5MPa and -152.9MPa at the identical points by forming analysis using the ABAQUS explicit. This results suggests that the residual stress error in the actual SPR joint and the analytical model was 12.8% and 17.2%, respectively. Vickers hardness values of the SPR joint were compared to the strain of the joint from the forming analysis results. It is deemed that the strain hardening occurred during the SPR forming process.
 In addition, the static and fatigue strengths were evaluated at loading angles of 0, 45, and 90 degrees using a dynamic universal testing machine. For static strength, the smaller the load angle, the greater the maximum static strength. The fatigue strength of the joint was evaluated by performing a structural analysis at various load amplitude to identify the stress concentration that occur on the SPR joints. Structural analysis is based on the model with actual cross-section without residual stress distribution and on the model with and without residual stresses. The von-Mises stress, the maximum principal stress, and the SWT parameter were adopted for the tensile-shear and cross-shaped specimens. The maximum principal stress is found to be appropriate to evaluate the fatigue strengths of the SPR joint under various loading conditions, rather than von-Mises stress and SWT parameter. The relationship between the maximum principal stress amplitude and the number of cycles is σ1=472.7·Nf-0.13

7665.title_ko: 접촉면의 초기 공극을 고려한 동적 물성 계수 결정에 관한 연구
7665.title_en: A Study for Determining Dynamic Mechanical Properties considering Initial Gap on Contact Surfaces
7665.author: 장택진
7665.abstract_ko: 재료가 고 변형률 속도로 변형될 때, 소성 유동 응력은 변형률 속도와 온도에 많은 영향을 끼치기 때문에 Split Hopkinson Pressure Bar (SHPB) 를 이용한 고 변형률 속도 조건에서 응력-변형률 관계를 도출하는 연구가 많이 진행되어 왔다. 또한 마찰, 편심, 편각, 조인트 등 다양한 환경 변수가 끼치는 영향에 대해서도 많이 연구되었다. 그러나 접촉면의 공극이 끼치는 영향에 관한 연구는 아직 이루어지지 아니하였다. 따라서, 본 연구에서는 SHPB 시험에서 시편과 봉 사이의 초기 공극이 미치는 영향에 관해 연구하였다. 초기 공극이 압축되면서 발생하는 현상을 초기 공극 압축 효과로 정의하였고, 초기 공극 압축 효과를 시편의 표면 거칠기를 조절함으로써 해석적으로 확인하였다. 같은 방법으로 초기 공극 압축 효과를 실험적으로 확인하였다. 유한요소 해석의 효율성을 증대시키기 위해 등가 공극 보상 모델을 제안하였고, 제안된 등가 모델을 사용하여 최적화 방법을 이용하여 동적 물성 계수를 결정하는 방법을 제안하였다. 또한, 계수 결정의 정확도를 높이기 위해 마찰계수를 측정하였고, 수렴성을 높이기 위해 재료의 항복 응력을 결정하였다. 결과적으로, 제안된 방법을 통해 정확도 높은 Johnson-Cook (JC) 모델 계수를 결정하였고, 결정된 JC 모델 계수가 다양한 변형률 속도 조건에서도 신뢰성 높게 적용됨을 확인하였다. 결정된 JC 모델 계수를 사용하여 공극 보상 모델과 기준모델을 비교하였고, 기준모델의 정확도가 낮은 것을 확인하였다. 따라서, 본 연구에서 제안한 초기 공극 압축 효과가 신뢰성 높은 동적 물성 계수 결정에 필수적임을 확인하였다.
7665.abstract_en: When the material is deformed at a high strain rate, the plastic flow stress is highly dependent on the strain rate and temperature. So, many studies for the stress-strain relationship at high strain rate condition was conducted using the Split Hopkinson Pressure Bar (SHPB) test. As well as, studies about the effect of the friction, eccentricity, declination, and joint were also conducted. But, no study has been conducted about the effect of the gap on the contact surfaces. In this study, the effect of the initial gap between the specimen and bars in the SHPB test was studied. The process of compressing initial gap of rough surface on contact surfaces was defined as Initial Gap Compression (IGC). The IGC effect on measured stress-strain relation was confirmed experimentally and numerically by adjusting the surface roughness. A equivalent gap compensation method was proposed for efficient finite element analysis considering the IGC effect. The methodology for determining Johnson-Cook (JC) coefficients using the optimization-based inverse method and the proposed equivalent gap model was presented. Also, the friction coefficients were measured to increase the accuracy of the determined coefficient. As a result, it was shown that accurate JC coefficients were determined using the proposed methodology, and then determined JC coefficients were reliable for various strain rates. Also, stress-strain relations obtained with the initial gap compensated and without gap compensation have been compared to show the necessity of the gap compensation. Consequently, it was shown that the consideration IGC effect is essential for accurate determination of plastic constitutive model parameters.

7674.title_ko: 조선업 도급작업의 안전관리 개선방안에 관한 연구
7674.title_en: A study on the improvements of safety management of subcontract work for shipbuilding industry
7674.author: 윤성원
7674.abstract_en: Korea was in the midst of an "ultimate boom" in 2001 when it topped the list of orders from Japan, which once dominated the shipbuilding industry. The core of the competitiveness was to strive to mass-produce high value-added ships such as drillships and LNG carriers to win the competition with Japan, and to minimize direct employment and reduce labor costs through subcontracting in case of high volatility in orders due to the characteristics of the shipbuilding industry. In particular, considering that 20 to 30 percent of the price of the ship is labor costs, it is expected that the use of the shipbuilding contract will continue after that. It is true that the scope of the safety and health measures of contractors is gradually expanding and the use of the subcontracts is becoming more difficult in the current era when the responsibilities of the contractors are also. Over the past four to five years, tens of thousands of people had left the shipyard due to the restructuring of the workforce in the wake of the slump in the shipbuilding industry, but the number of new workers has been increasing recently, focusing on large shipyards. However, it is difficult for the filling workers to adapt to the complex safety management system at large shipyards due to the lack of experience in shipyards and the lack of safety management system, which is highly likely to cause various safety management problems and accidents. The Industrial Safety and Health Act, which should serve as the standard for industrial accidents prevention for shipyards that require more systematic safety management due to the increase in subcontracting and new workforce, is not doing its job properly. The Industrial Safety Act does not reflect the reality of safety management in the shipbuilding industry, which lacks many aspects to achieve its original goal of preventing industrial accidents and weakens the responsibility of contractors for safety management. In this study, we are going to make a contribution to preventing industrial accidents by analyzing the problems of the revision of the Industrial Safety and Health Act, focusing on the subcontracting safety management of the shipbuilding industry, and suggesting desirable measures to increase the effectiveness of the Industrial Safety and Health Act in the shipbuilding industry based on this study.

7686.author: 파들리
7686.abstract_ko: 예측 헤드 트래킹은 클라우드 가상 현실에서 대기 시간 문제를 처리하는 시스템입니다. 신규 사용자의 편의를 위해 시스템은 작은 샘플을 사용하여 더 빨리 훈련해야합니다. 메타 학습 접근법 중 하나 인 MAML (Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning)은 MAML이 이전 작업의 구조를 학습하여 작동하기 때문에 적은 수의 기울기 단계 만 사용하여 샘플이 거의없는 새로운 작업을 학습하는 것으로 간주됩니다. 이 연구는 클라우드 가상 현실 시스템을 위해 MAML을 통해 예측 헤드 추적을 구현합니다. 메타 러닝 사용의 이점을 보여주기 위해서는 빠른 학습 능력의 입증과 이전의 접근법과의 비교가 필요합니다. 또한 MAML 속성은 MAML 매개 변수가 오류 성능에 미치는 영향을 보여줍니다. 우리의 결과는 MAML을 사용한 예측 헤드 트래킹이 TOE (Train on Everything), Scratch에서 Train 및 Joint Training을 포함한 다른 접근 방식 중에서 최고의 성능을 생성 함을 확인합니다. 필요한 경우, 점점 더 많은 수의 적응 단계 및 많은 수의 적응 샘플이 MAML 시스템을 개선 할 수있다.
7686.abstract_en: Predictive head tracking is a system to handle the latency issue in cloud virtual reality. For the convenience of new users, the system needs to train faster using a small sample. Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML), one of meta-learning approach, is considered to learn a new task with few samples using only a small number of gradient step because MAML works by learning the structure of the previous tasks. This study implements predictive head tracking via MAML for the cloud virtual reality system. Demonstration of fast learning ability and comparison with prior approaches are needed to show the benefit of using meta-learning. In addition, MAML properties show how MAML parameters affect the error performance. Our results confirm that predictive head tracking using MAML produces the best performance among the other approaches including Train on Everything (TOE), Train from Scratch, and Joint Training. If necessary, an increasing number of adaptation steps and number of adaptation samples can improve MAML system.

7694.title_ko: 악취 물질 제거를 위한 비탄소계 기반 다중 흡착 필터 개발
7694.title_en: Development of multiple adsorption filter with non-carbon sorbent for odor compounds removal
7694.author: 노규영
7694.abstract_en: The most-prevalent odor compounds in restaurants that serve grilled meat are aldehydes, ammonia, and hydrogen sulfide. Aldehydes make the greatest contribution to complex odors, followed by ammonia and hydrogen sulfide. In this study, we developed a multiple-adsorption filter that can remove the complex odor compounds that are common in restaurants. Carbon-free adsorbents are used in the filter, and several candidate materials were chosen for their ability to adsorb acetaldehyde, ammonia, and hydrogen sulfide. First, we tested silica gel samples pretreated at different temperatures for their ability to adsorb ammonia. We found that pretreatment at 150℃ offers excellent adsorption performance. Then, pressure-reduction desorption experiments were conducted to test how well the silica-gel filter can be regenerated. Regeneration conditions were tested by varying both the desorption pressure and time and the cross-sectional area and height of the adsorbent. The desorption pressure and duration exceeded –40 kPa and 1.5 hr. The desorption conditions were set so that the filter had cross-sectional area of 10 cm2 and height of 1 cm or less. Next, we tested this medium’s effectiveness for removing ammonia, and we found that when ammonia and hydrogen sulfide adsorbed in silica gel, these compounds react, so we tested activated alumina instead. To improve this material’s adsorption performance for ammonia, the alumina surface was modified with metal and acid, and its ammonia-adsorption properties were measured. Activated alumina modified with tin had the best adsorption performance of the samples that we surface-modified with acids and metals. The surface properties of this activated alumina material were confirmed with Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) and Fourier-Transform Infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR) images. Finally, to improve the performance of Layered Double Hydroxide (LDH) as a sorbent for hydrogen sulfide, we prepared sample filters by attaching LDH to polyurethane foam (PUF) using either a dipping and spraying. The sorbent performed better when LDH was sprayed onto the PUF. The surface properties of these samples were analyzed with SEM, FT-IR, and X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements. Finally, we prepared multiple-adsorption filters with silica gel and LDH+PUF filled in different orders, to test which performed best. Multiple-adsorption filters with the first stage as LDH+PUF and the second stage as silica gel were found to perform best at adsorbing compounds in complex restaurant odor, especially acetaldehyde and ammonia. Continuous-adsorption experiments using complex odors of acetaldehyde and hydrogen sulfide showed acetaldehyde removal efficiency of 96.2 ± 1.4% and hydrogen sulfide removal efficiency of 99.9 ± 0.1%. These results confirm that two-stage adsorption filters with silica gel and LDH+PUF are effective for filtering acetaldehyde and hydrogen sulfide. If surface-modified activated alumina were to be added to the multiple-adsorption filter to remove ammonia, we expect that that all three complex odor compounds common in restaurants that serve grilled meat would be filtered simultaneously.

7699.author: 허순범
7699.abstract_ko:
본 연구는 기후변화협약에 의한 이산화탄소배출 저감과 정부의 에너지 정책에 따라 국내 석탄 화력 발전소는 발전수명이 종료되는 발전소를 단계적으로 폐쇄하기로 하였다. 이에 폐쇄가 결정되는 발전소의 경우 석탄에서 바이오매스 연료인 우드펠릿(Wood pellet)으로 연료 전환 공사를 수행하여 바이오매스 발전소로 전환하여 운영할 수 있다. 그러나 석탄을 연소한 후 발생하는 석탄회(Coal Ash)와 달리 우드펠릿을 연소한 재는 유효 이용(Beneficial Use) 및 재활용이 현재까지 이루어지고 있지 않으며 관련한 연구실적도 적극적으로 이루어지지 않고 있어 우드펠릿 연소회는 전량 매립 및 폐기물로 처리되고 있는 현실이다. 이와 더불어 운영 중인 회사장(Ash pond)은 매립되는 회(Ash)의 증가로 인하여 만지(포화)가 예상되어 수명 연장을 위해 중장비를 동원하여 매립된 회를 폐기물로 외부 반출하여야 하는 실정으로 신규 회사장 건설, 연소회의 유효 이용 및 매립 회(Ash) 감소 등의 대안 수립이 필요한 상황이 되었다. 
 국내 석탄화력 발전사가 석탄에서 바이오매스 연료인 우드펠릿으로 연료 전환 공사를 실시 후 발생할 수 있는 문제점을 파악하고 연료의 재활용을 도모할 수 있는 이송 설비를 구성하여 자원의 재활용과 폐기물 저감에 기여하기를 기대한다.
7699.abstract_en:
In this study, domestic coal-fired power plants are to be phased out at the end of their lifespan in accordance with the CO2 emission reduction under the Climate Change Convention and the government's energy policy. In the case of a power plant that is determined to be closed, a fuel conversion construction from coal to wood pellets, which is a biomass fuel, may be performed to convert to a biomass power plant. However, unlike coal ash produced after burning coal, wood pellet burned ash has not yet been used and recycled. The reality is that all of this is being disposed of in landfills and waste. In addition, the operating company (Ash pond) is expected to be touched (saturated) due to the increase in ash that is buried, and the new company needs to take out the landfilled ash as waste by using heavy equipment to extend its life. There is a need to establish alternatives such as construction of the field, effective use of combustion ash and reduction of ash.
 We hope that domestic coal-fired power plants will contribute to recycling resources and reducing waste by identifying transport problems that can occur after converting fuel from coal to wood pellets, which are biomass fuels. Expect.

7700.title_ko: Anatase와 Rutile 결정상 비율에 따른 TiO₂nanotube plate의 광촉매 활성 비교 연구
7700.title_en: Comparison of photocatalytic activity of TiO2 nanotube plate depending on crystallographic ratio of anatase and rutile
7700.author: 이효주
7700.abstract_en: Today, contaminant treatment has reached its limit due to active industrial activities, and there is an urgent need to deal with contaminants more efficiently. In this study, UV/TiO2, one of the advanced oxidation processes, was used. During the photocatalytic reaction, OH radicals are generated and they have an excellent oxidation capability for wastewater treatment. This study was carried out to improve the photocatalytic reaction of TiO2 photocatalyst. TiO2 nanotubes were grown on a titanium plate by anodization. The annealing temperature for TiO2 nanotube was varied from 400 to 900℃ and the crystal forms of the TiO2 nanotube was analyzed. When heat-treated at different temperatures, a mixture of rutile and anatase crystal phases were observed from 700 ℃. Depending on annealing temperature, TiO2 nanotubes have shown different crystal forms; 0% rutile (100% anatase), 18.4% rutile (81.6% anatase), 36.6% rutile (63.4% anatase) and 98.6% rutile (1.4% anatase). As the ratio of rutile crystal structure increased, the absorbance wavelength moved to the visible wavelength. To compare the photocatalytic activity according to the crystal structure ratio by monitored the concentration of OH radical probe compound (p-Chlorobenzoic acid). UV lamps of various wavelengths were used UVC lamp (254 nm), UVB lamp (306 nm) and UVA lamp (360 nm). As a result, 18.4% rutile (81.6% anatase)-TiO2 was produced more OH radicals than 100% anatase-TiO2.

7709.title_en: Neurotoxicity of Phthalates in Zebrafish Embryos
7709.author: 도응억진
7709.abstract_en: Due to the recent use of phthalates as plasticizers and solvents in products, their distribution in the environmental matrices and human body have been reported. Phthalates are commonly known as endocrine disruptors and are suspected to interfere with neurodevelopment. Unfortunately, these phthalate relatives are without neuronal toxicity profiles. Hence, the objective of this study was to investigate the basic toxicity and neurotoxicity of the six phthalates including dimethyl phthalate (DMP), diisononyl phthalate (DINP), diethyl phthalate (DEP), di-2-ethylhexyl phthalate (DEHP), benzyl butyl phthalate (BBZP), and di-n-octyl phthalate (DNOP) using an in vivo model, zebrafish. All six target phthalates induced abnormal development of heartbeat after 24 hours of exposure. The preliminary results indicated that BBZP, DEHP, and DINP may injure the zebrafish nervous system through altering behavior profile. BBZP, DEHP, and DINP also had impacts on the zebrafish neurogenesis. Moreover, DINP and BBZP inhibited neural crest migration and myelination, respectively. For gene expression, DINP and DEHP increased mRNA of ache expression. BBZP and DEHP also reduced mRNA level of th gene while DINP increased drd1b transcriptional amount. For DMP, DEP, and DNOP, there is inadequate evidence in zebrafish and laboratory animals to consider as neurotoxicants. BBZP, DINP, and DEHP exposure had different impacts on the nervous system development which potentially lead to different behavioral profiles of 5-day-old zebrafish.

7719.title_en: Improved adsorption performance of heavy metals by surface modified polypropylene/polyethylene media through acrylic acid and disulfide polymer
7719.author: 홍정민
7719.abstract_ko:
기후변화와 함께 예상치 못한 강우량이 발생하며 불투수면이나 농업 등에서 강우유출수 발생이 증가하였고, 이에 따라 광범위한 유해오염물질이 배출되어 환경문제를 일으킬 수 있다. 도시 강우 유출수는 도시의 포장된 표면으로 인해 자연적 여과가 제한되어 있어 도로의 오염물질이 그대로 하천이나 수계로 유입되는 경우가 있다. 오염물질 중에 중금속의 상당량 유출되며, 중금속은 내구성이 강하며 인체에 축적이 쉽기 때문에 건강문제와 환경문제를 동반하여 발생한다. 보고된 자료에 의하면 한강 수계에 기준치를 초과한 중금속이 종종 나타났다. 이미 중금속을 제거하는 입증된 방법은 많이 있지만, 불규칙하고 통제가 되지 않는 강우유출수의 중금속 제거는 불확실성이 크다. 따라서 본 연구에서는 강우유출수와 같은 비점오염원의 중금속 제거에 목적을 두었고, 실제 비점오염 저감시설에서 사용하는 폴리프로필렌과 폴리에틸렌으로 구성된 입상여재 (PP)와 섬유여재 (PP/PE)연구를 진행했다. 
 폴리프로필렌과 폴리에틸렌과 같은 플라스틱의 표면은 화학물질에 불활성이고 소수성인 특성을 가지고 있다. 따라서 플라스틱 여재의 성능향상을 위해 먼저 산소플라즈마로 하이드록실기를 부착하여 플라스틱 표면에 변화를 주었고 중금속을 효과적으로 흡착한다는 선행연구를 바탕으로 아크릴산을 추가로 합성했다. 이를 PP-AA, PP/PE-AA 라고 명명하였으며, FT-IR, SEM/EDS 등으로 소재의 물리적 특성을 평가하고 Fe, Mn, Cd 흡착평가로 화학적 성능을 확인하였다. PP-AA의 경우 최대 94%가 제거되는 효과를 볼 수 있었으며, 산소플라즈마와 아크릴산 합성으로 용존성 오염물질을 제거 가능성을 확인하였다. 반면, PP/PE-AA의 경우 아크릴산 합성이 PP/PE의 투수성 및 비표면적 변화를 일으켜 중금속 흡착이 미비했다. 따라서 중금속 이온에 대한 높은 흡착 선택성이 달성된 이황화 고분자를 PP/PE-AA에 추가로 합성시켰다. 이것을 Dis-PP/PE 라 명명하였고, 중금속 흡착평가를 통해 Dis-PP/PE의 중금속 흡착 성능 향상을 확인하였다.
7719.abstract_en:
Unexpected rainfall has occurred along with climate change, and rainfall outflows have increased in impervious surfaces and agriculture, which can cause a wide range of harmful pollutants and cause environmental problems. Urban rainfall runoff has limited natural filtration due to urban pavimented surfaces, which can lead to road contaminants entering rivers and water systems. A significant amount of heavy metals are spilled in pollutants, and heavy metals are accompanied by health and environmental problems because they have long term effects, particularly in the human body. Reported data often show heavy metals exceeding the standard in the Han River. There are already many proven methods for removing heavy metals, but the removal of heavy metals from irregular and uncontrolled rainfall runoff is highly uncertain. Therefore, this study aimed at the removal of heavy metals from non-point sources such as rainfall runoff, and the study of PP and PP/PE composed of polypropylene and polyethylene used in actual non-point pollution reduction facilities.
 Plastic surfaces such as polypropylene and polyethylene are inert to chemicals and hydrophobic. Therefore, in order to improve the performance of plastic media, first, hydroxyl group was attached to oxygen plasma to change plastic surface, and acrylic acid was further synthesized based on the previous research to effectively adsorbs heavy metals. This was named PP-AA, PP/PE-AA, and the physical properties of the material were evaluated by FT-IR, SEM/EDS, and the chemical performance was confirmed by Fe, Mn, Cd adsorption evaluation. In the case of PP-AA, a maximum of 94% was removed, and the possibility of removing dissolved pollutants was confirmed by the synthesis of oxygen plasma and acrylic acid. On the other hand, in the case of PP/PE-AA, acrylic acid synthesis caused a change in permeability and specific surface area of PP/PE, resulting in insufficient adsorption of heavy metals. Therefore, disulfide polymers with high adsorption selectivity for heavy metal ions were further synthesized in PP/PE-AA. This new material was named Dis-PP/PE, and heavy metal adsorption evaluation confirmed the improvement of the heavy metal adsorption performance of Dis-PP/PE.

7721.title_en: An evaluation of various efficiency of the permeable block facility
7721.author: 한상윤
7721.abstract_en: Currently, nonpoint pollution from nonpoint sources causes the soil and other pollutants, including heavy metals and oils, to be washed away with rainwater to contaminate rivers. Therefore, in order to manage nonpoint pollution in Korea, the government is conducting research on low impact development (LID) facilities and various efficiency evaluations. In this study, the inflow and outflow pollutant EMC analysis, pollutant load analysis, water balance analysis, and pollutant reduction efficiency analysis of permeable block facilities actually installed among various LID facilities were performed. A correlation analysis of the factor, runoff and pollutant reduction efficiency was conducted. When the average runoff reduction efficiency was analyzed in consideration of rainfall events, the result was 35.7% for impervious packaging, 62.8% for filter permeable packaging, and 76.1% for crevice permeable packaging. In addition, we analyzed the correlation between climate factor, runoff and pollutant reduction efficiency, and found a significant correlation in crevice type pavement facilities when analyzing the reduction effect according to rainfall and rainfall intensity.

7724.title_ko: Fabrication of Complex Structures Using  Soft Materials and Applications
7724.title_en: 연성재료를 사용한 복잡한 구조의 제작과 응용
7724.author: 이혜민
7724.abstract_ko: 비대칭구조와 복잡한 구조는 미세 유체, 안개 수집, 광학 및 소프트 로봇 공학과 같은 다양한 응용으로 인해 많은 분야에서 연구되어왔다. 하지만 비대칭 구조와 복잡한 구조의 제조 공정이 복잡하다는 단점이 있고 하이드로겔과 같은 스마트 물질을 복잡한 구조와 조합하면 복잡한 구조의 응용 분야를 확장 할 수 있기 때문에 복잡한 구조를 연구하는 것은 여전히 ​​흥미로운 분야이다.    본 논문에서는 복잡한 구조에 관한 3가지 연구를 제시한다. 먼저, 소프트 빔과 래칫 구조에서 간단한 굽힘 방법을 사용하여 측면 좌굴 구조를 제작하고 빔의 구조와 곡률에 따라 좌굴 구조를 조절했으며 굽힘 부분적 주름구조를 형성하는 구조를 제작하여 위조방지 등에 이용가능한 필름을 제작하였다. 둘째로 비대칭 구조와 하이드로 겔 재료를 결합하여 비대칭 하이드로 겔 원기둥 구조를 제작하고 주위환경에 따라 기둥간의 클러스터링 과 자가회복에 대하여 연구하였다. 또한 하이드로 겔 기둥의 자가회복을 광학 필름에 적용하여 환경에 의해 투명도가 변화하는 스마트 광학 필름을 제작하였다. 마지막으로, 복잡한 구조의 제작방식을 단순화하기 위해 하이드로 겔 변형을 통해 복잡한 구조를 제작하는 방법을 제안했다. 또한 습한 조건에서만 변형을 유지하는 하이드로겔의 단점을 해결하기 위해 리몰딩 기법을 이용하여 변형된 하이드로겔로부터 구조를 복제했다. 제작된 구조는 건조한 환경에서도 구조를 유지할 수 있으며 복제된 구조물로부터 PDMS를 이용하여 몰드를 제작하면 다양한 고분자를 이용하여 복잡한 구조를 제작할 수 있다. 복잡한 구조 제작을 위해 음각의 사각기둥 구조와 양각의 빔 구조를 이용하여 재진입 및 좌굴 구조를 제작하였고 제작된 재진입 및 좌굴 구조는 소유성 표면 및 충격 완화 필름에 적용하였다
7724.abstract_en: The asymmetric and complex structures have been interested in many studies because of their various application such as microfluidics, fog-harvesting, optics, and soft robotics. The fabrication processes of asymmetric and complex structures are still complex. Although, the combination of smart materials and complex structures, such as hydrogels, can be exploded the application filed of complex structures. Thus, it still remains intriguing to study complex structures. In this paper, we present the three-chapter about complex structures. First, we fabricated lateral buckling structures using a simple bending method from soft beam and ratchet structures. we demonstrate the shape-dependent of the wrinkles on the curvature and geometry of the beam. Second, we combined asymmetric structure with hydrogel materials. the asymmetric hydrogel molds are clustering and recovering during the environment around them is changed. for this method, we can solve the problem of the clustering issue of pillars. Although, this self-recovery of slented hydrogel pillars can be applied for optics film. During the pillars clustering and recovering the transparency is changed and we can use it for smart windows. Lastly, we proposed a new fabrication method for complex structures via hydrogel deformations. The studied about hydrogel deformations has been interested in the fabrication of complex structures due to their property changing in humid condition. Though, these deformations occur only in the humid condition. The complex structures fabricated via our system are can maintain their structure even if the dry condition. for that, we remolded the complex patterns from deformed hydrogel mold before they are recovered. We prepared engraved squared patterns and embossed line patterns to fabricate complex structure and we found a suitable condition via some experiments and fabricated reentrant and buckling structures. the fabricated reentrant and buckling structures can be applied for oleophobic surfaces and shock dissipation films. Although, we can replicate the same structures by soft lithography and thermal- nanoimprint using reusable PDMS molds that fabricated from fabricated structures.

7725.title_ko: Smart interlocking controlled by stimuli with asymmetric hydrogel bilayer structures
7725.title_en: 비대칭 하이드로젤 바이레이어 구조를 통하여 자극에 따라 조절되는 스마트 인터라킹
7725.author: 배용호
7725.abstract_en:
Smart technologies for actively responding to changes in the external environment have been studied for years and exist in various forms. It was studied to react to environmental changes such as external temperature and humidity by using the properties of various polymers.
In this paper, an asymmetric ratchet structure was fabricated using hydrogel polymers with the characteristic of absorbing and expanding water between polymer networks and changing its shape. We have studied smart interlocking where unlocking occurs due to the change of external environment in ratchet engagement. We have demonstrated the role of oxygen in the formation of bilayers of hydrogel in response to different external conditions in the fabrication of asymmetric ratchets. In the unlocking process using hydrogel bilayer structure, the dominant external environment and its deformation were shown for asymmetric ratchet and substrate, respectively. Through these results, we proposed a smart gripper that works according to the surrounding environment.

7727.title_ko: The Performance Evaluation of Aqueous Redox Flow Batteries Using Various Types of Redox Couple
7727.title_en: 다양한 유형의 산화 환원 커플을 이용한 수계 산화 환원 흐름 전지의 성능 평가
7727.author: 추천호

7728.title_ko: A Study on Electron Mediator and Enzyme Immobilization Method for Improving Enzymatic Biofuel Cell Performance
7728.title_en: A Study on Electron Mediator and Enzyme Immobilization Method for Improving Enzymatic Biofuel Cell Performance
7728.author: 현규환
7728.abstract_ko:
본 연구에서는 효소기반 바이오연료전지 성능을 높이기 위해, Anode극에 사용되는 Glucose Oxidase(GOx)의 성능을 최대한 끌어올리는 연구를 진행하였다. 이를 위해 Biofuel-cell에 적용할 수 있는 적합한 전자전달자를 조사하였고 이후 GOx와 전자전달자 복합 촉매 만들어 바이오연료전지에 적용 시켰다. 
전자전달자는 기존부터 널리 사용된 1,4-benzoquinone부터 시작해서, 1,4-naphthoquinone, 9,10-anthraquinone, 4-nitrobenzoic acid, tetrathiafulvalene(TTF) 등을 촉매 복합체에 적용하여 이의 성능을 비교하였다. 또한, 이를 담지체에 GOx와 함께 효과적으로 담지하기 위해 Chitosan, gelatin과 같은 고분자를 사용하여 GOx와 전자전달자를 포획하거나, Genipin, glutaraldehyde와 같은 가교제를 활용하여 촉매 이탈 방지막을 형성하여 촉매의 안정성을 향상시켰다. 반전지 측정 결과, 제조된 촉매 중 CNT/[TTF-GOx]/Gelatin+GA가 가장 높은 전기화학적 성능과 장기안정성을 보여주었는데, 이는 Gelatin의 친수성 성질이 소수성을 띄는 TTF의 이탈을 1차적으로 방지해주고 GA로 인해 TTF의 외벽이 소수성 성질로 변하여 GOx의 이탈과 Gelatin 구조체가 무너지는 걸을 방지해 주었기 때문이다. 상기, 제조된 촉매를 이용하여 효소바이오연료전지의 모사구동 결과, 이 또한 가장 우수한 183.2 µW·cm-2이라는 값을 나타냈는데 이는 Quinone 유도체, 4-Nitrobenzoic acid 등을 적용한 것에 비하여 큰 폭으로 개선된 결과이다. 마지막으로, 효소이탈 현상이 발생하는지 가시선 분광분석법- 비색법을 통해 4주 간 이탈 현상을 관찰하였다. 그 결과 4주 간 이탈한 효소량은 0.0 unit에 수렴했으며 이는 기존에는 볼 수 없었던 획기적인 결과임을 나타낸다.

7729.title_ko: Metallic Seed-Adsorbed Nanoflowers as High Performance Anode Modification for Yeast-Based Microbial Fuel Cells
7729.title_en: 이스트 마이크로바이알 연료전지를 위한 금속나노플라워 기반 산화극 연구
7729.author: 듀아트 킴벌리
7729.abstract_en: The growth of metallic and metallic oxide nanoflowers grown atop polyethylenimine functionalized carbon felt via surface-bound metallic seeds is explored with the aid of either surfactant or living-biotemplate mediation. The procedures discussed are performed in simple one-pot, green, and ambient conditions to develop three individual and unique nanoflower structures: multi-branched gold nanoflowers, core-shell iron-manganese oxide nanoflowers, and living-template titanium dioxide nanoflowers. The nanoflower decorated felts are implemented as the anode within a yeast-based microbial fuel cell system. Widespread and unique nanoflower structures are developed in each case and the structure, morphology, and electrochemical performance of the nanoflowers and their effect on the maturation and attachment of yeast cells are examined through electrochemical analytical testing, surface coverage analysis, visual imagery, and optimal inspection. The developmental growth of the nanoflowers with their individual beneficial mediation procedures are observed to have an effect on the condition of the yeast biofilm inhabitancy, viability, and the resulting electrochemical behaviour. Through data collection and characterization, the yeast biofilm is found to thrive and excel in each of the metallic nanoflower works, with each result building upon and improving over the last. The most optimal results in maximum power density were 2771±569 mW·m-2 for the gold nanoflowers, 5838±613 mW·m-2 for the iron and manganese oxide nanoflowers, and 21±2 W·m-2 for the titanium dioxide living-template nanoflowers.

7731.title_ko: 화학물질을 감지하는 전도성 나노 충전제를 함유한 아가로스 기반의 마이크로 섬유
7731.title_en: Chemical-Sensing Composite Microfibers Containing Conducting Nanofillers in Agarose Matrix
7731.author: 박예진
7731.abstract_ko:
본 논문에서는 친수성 고분자인 아가로스와 탄소 기반 나노 충전제를 함유한 마이크로 섬유 화학적 센서들을 소개한다. 첫 번째로, 1가 알코올 센서로서 높은 습도에서 CNT를 내부에 포함하는 아가로스 섬유를 소개한다. 이 섬유는 외부의 알코올과 섬유 내부의 물의 확산과 침투가 이루어질 때 확산 속도에 따른 섬유의 부피 변화로 인한 전기적 저항 변화를 통해 메탄올부터 1-펜타놀까지 감지할 수 있다. 이 섬유는 1wt% CNT를 함유한 100㎛ 지름의 섬유에서 가장 빠르고 명확한 알코올 감지가 가능했다. 물과 에탄올 희석액과 술, 메탄올과 에탄올 희석액을 통해 실용적인 활용 가능성과 알코올 감지 기능성이 확인되었다.
두 번째로는 서로 다른 나노 충전제를 함유한 두 가지의 마이크로 섬유 습도 센서들을 소개한다. 이 섬유들은 각각 아가로스 고분자에 reduced graphene oxide/silver nanowire (rGO/AgNW) 그리고 CNT를 함유한다. 두 센서 모두 충전제의 첨가로 기계적 물성과 전기적 전도도가 향상된 것을 확인할 수 있었고, 습도에 대한 저항 변화의 빠른 경향성과 재사용성, 반복성을 신뢰할 만한 수준으로 확인할 수 있었다. rGO/AgNW를 함유한 마이크로 섬유는 물 분자의 이온화에 따라 습도가 증가할수록 비저항이 감소하는 경향을 보였다. 반면, CNT를 함유한 마이크로 섬유는 습도에 따른 아가로스의 부피 변화에 의한 CNT간의 연결 변화에 따라 습도가 증가할수록 비저항이 증가하는 경향을 보였다. 우리는 이렇게 상반되는 경향이 이온의 흐름과 전자의 흐름의 경쟁적 관계에서 나오며, 이는 충전제의 농도에 따라 조절할 수 있다는 가설을 세웠다. 그에 따라 본 논문에서는 충전제의 농도에 따른 습도에 대한 비저항의 변화를 측정하고, 임피던스 분석을 수행하여 충전제를 함유한 고분자 습도 센서에서의 메커니즘에 대한 연구를 진행하였다.
7731.abstract_en:
This paper introduces various microfiber-typed chemical sensors containing carbon-based nanofillers in hydrophilic agarose polymer. First, we introduce a agarose fiber containing CNTs at high humidity as a normal alcohol sensor. The fiber can detect from methanol to 1-pentanol through the change in electrical resistance due to the volume change of the fiber with the different diffusion rate when the outside alcohol and water inside the fiber are diffused and penetrated. The fiber showed the fastest and clearest alcohol detection on 100 µm diameter fiber containing 1wt% CNT. By detecting diluted solution of water and ethanol, liquor, and diluted solution of methanol and ethanol, the fiber showed their practical applicability and ability to alcohol detection.
Secondly, two types of microfiber humidity sensors containing different nanofillers are introduced. These fibers contain reduced graphene oxide / silver nanowires (rGO / AgNW) and CNTs in the agarose polymer, respectively. Both sensors showed improved mechanical properties and electrical conductivity by means of the addition of fillers. Moreover, their rapid and reliable humidity-dependent response, reversibility and repeatability were demonstrated. In the case of the microfiber containing rGO / AgNW shows decrease in resistivity as the humidity increases due to the ionization of water molecules. On the other hand, the CNT-containing microfiber show increase in resistivity as the humidity increases with the change in the connection between CNTs due to the volume change of agarose with humidity. We hypothesized that this opposite tendency comes from the competitive relationship between the flow of ions and the flow of electrons, which can be controlled by the concentration of the filler. Therefore, in this paper, the changes of resistivity on humidity varying the concentrations of filler were measured, and electrical impedance analysis was performed to study the mechanism in the polymer humidity sensor containing nanofillers.

7741.title_ko: 신재생 에너지원과 결합된 멀티-ESS SoC의 상하한과 밸런싱 제약 조건을 달성하는 MPC를 이용한 충방전 알고리즘
7741.title_en: Optimal Energy Management of Renewable Generation using Multiple Energy Storage Under Constraints
7741.author: 한니프 파니탄
7741.abstract_ko: 신재생 에너지 자원의 본질적인 간헐성 때문에, 마이크로그리드의 효용성은 에너지 저장 장치 (ESS, Energy Storage Systems)를 추가하여 향상될 수 있다. 본 연구는 lookup-table 타입 모델 예측 제어(MPC, Model Predictive Control)를 이용하여 다중 에너지 저장 장치(ESU, Energy Storage Unit)로 구성된 ESS의 최적 충전 및 방전 알고리즘을 제안한다. 이 알고리즘은 각 ESU의 SoC 밸런싱을 수행하고 전력 변환기의 충전 상태(SoC, State of Charge) 및 전류치 상하한 조건을 충족하도록 한다. 울트라 캐패시터와 신재생 에너지원 시뮬레이터를 이용한 모의 실험 및 실제 실험에서 제안하는 알고리즘이 효과적으로 동작함을 보였다.
7741.abstract_en: Due to the intrinsic intermittent nature of renewable energy source, their utility in a microgrid can be enhanced by adding an energy storage system (ESS). Using a lookup table type MPC (Model Predictive Control), this study presents an optimal charging and discharging algorithm for the ESS which consists of multiple energy storage unit (ESU). The algorithm is designed to enable the integration of renewable energy and an ESS to dispatch scheduled power while performing cell balancing for each ESU as well as satisfying the constraints on state of charge (SoC) and current limits in power converters. Simulation and experimental results using ultra-capacitors as ESUs in a DC microgrid are presented here to show the effectiveness of the proposed charging and discharging algorithm.

7742.title_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 부하예측과 SMP 예측과 ESS 스케줄링에의 응용
7742.title_en: Deep Learning-Based Load Forecasting and Its Application to SMP Prediction and ESS Scheduling
7742.author: 유단타카
7742.abstract_ko: 부하 전력 예측은 전력 시스템 작동 및 유지보수에 있어 가장 중요한 작업 중 하나이며 그 정확도를 높이는 것은 전원 시스템 스케줄링에 도움이 될 수 있다. 본 학위논문에서는 주로 과거의 부하 전력 및 온도 데이터를 사용하여 수행되는 부하 전력의 예측에 부분 실시간 온도 정보를 사용하는 방법을 제시한다. 부분 실시간 온도 정보는 전체 예측 시간의 일부에 대한 온도 정보를 의미한다. 이를 위해 부하 전력을 예측하기 위해 LSTM(장기 단기 메모리) 네트워크를 과거의 온도와 부하 전원 데이터를 사용하여 훈련하며, 예측된 부하 전원은 간접적으로 온도 예측에 의존한다. 그런 다음 온도 예측 오류가 발생하는 경우를 처리하기 위해 온도 변동과 부하 전력 변동 사이의 관계를 설명하는 과거 데이터를 사용하여 딥러닝 네트워크를 훈련한다. 그런 다음 온도를 측정하고 보정 부하 예측을 LSTM와 입력값이 온도 예측 오류인 MLP의 출력을 추가하여 계산한다. 실시간 온도 정보를 이용하여 제안된 보상은 부하 전력 예측 성능을 실제로 향상시키는 것으로 나타났다. 이 개선된 부하 예측은 SMP(시스템 한계 가격)를 예측하고 ESS 일정을 만드는 데 사용된다. 시뮬레이션을 통하여 제안하는 방법이 부하 예측의 정확성을 높임을 확인하였다. 또한 향상된 부하 예측값을 이용하여 개선된 SMP 예측과 ESS 스케줄링을 달성함을 보였다.
7742.abstract_en: Load power forecasting is one of the most important tasks in the operation and maintenance of power systems. Improving its accuracy may be helpful in scheduling power systems. This paper presents how partial real-time temperature information can be used in the forecasting of load power, primarily using past load and temperature data. Partial real-time temperature information means temperature information only for part of the entire forecast time interval. To this end, the LSTM (Long-Term Short-Term Memory) network is trained using past temperature and load power data to predict load power, where the expected load power depends implicitly on the temperature forecast. In order to deal with non-trivial temperature prediction errors, the MLP (Multi-Layer Perceptron) network is trained using past data describing the relationship between temperature variation and load power variation. The temperature is then measured and the load forecast is calculated by adding the output of the LSTM and the output of the MLP, the input of which is a temperature forecast error. It is shown that the proposed compensation, using real-time temperature information, actually improves the performance of the load power forecast. This improved load forecast is used to predict SMP (System Marginal Price) and to make an ESS schedule as an application. Simulation shows that the improvement of the result can be achieved by using the offset load forecast as another consideration parameter.

7744.title_ko: Determination of Maximum Loadability for DC Microgrid using Nonlinear Interior Point Method
7744.title_en: 비선형 내점법을 이용한 DC 마이크로그리드의 Loadability 결정
7744.author: 크리 멩리엉
7744.abstract_ko: DC 마이크로그리드의 내에서 복잡성과 크기 측면에서 전력 시스템의 성장은 부하를 처리하기위한 시스템의 기능을 정량적으로 평가할 필요가 있습니다.이 논문에서 DC 마이크로 그리드 버스의 최대 실제 전력 부하는 기하학적으로 추적됩니다. dc 마이크로 그리드는 종래의 전력 시스템에서 사용되는 일반화 된 원형 다이어그램 접근 방식이 이러한 목적을 위해 드룹 제어 DC 마이크로 그리드에서 사용되도록 수정된다. DC 마이크로 그리드에 존재하는 상이한 유형의 버스가 기술되고, 그 후 일반화 된 원형 다이어그램 접근법을 적용함으로써 동작 지점의 위치가 획득된다. 제안 된 방법은 4 버스 dc 마이크로 그리드에서의 시뮬레이션으로 검증됩니다.
7744.abstract_en: An accurate model need  to be determined for power system components in order to reduce failures and uncertainties during service. The DC microgrid is droop-controlled with the variety kind of loads which is continuous increasing power loads, the fact is that loads are highly unpredictable, given the situation that consumers have varying power demands that increase through time. In DC microgrid system it is crucial for power system stability to be properly determined. Active power margin is used to measure the distance to instability, analyses by using computational methods are used to obtain P-V curve of power system. The maximum rated power load in a DC microgrid bus was geometrical drew for observing the characteristic and robustness of the system before it become unstable. And the purpose of this thesis is to provide a tool for determining the Loadability of DC microgrid by using an Interior Point (IP) method for non-linear optimization.

7745.title_ko: Deep-Learning based State Estimation for DC Microgrids using Modified Long Short-Term Memory Network
7745.title_en: 수정된 Long Short-Term Memory 네트워크를 이용한 DC 마이크로 그리드의 Deep-Learning 기반 상태 추정
7745.author: 파야 아디
7745.abstract_ko: DC 마이크로그리드에 대한 관심의 증가와 분배 시스템의 역할이 더욱 중요해짐에 따라 분배 시스템 상태 추정을 위한 개발이 불가피하다. 적절한 제와와 모니터링을 위해, 개발된 DC 마이크로그리드 신기술에 적용할 수 있는 상태 추정기가 필요하다. 본 논문은 주로 WLS를 손실 함수로 하는 LSTM 기반 상태 추정기를 수정하여 DC 마이크로그리드의 상태 추정을 다룬다. 특정 가중치는 WLS 손실 함수에 할당된다. 제안된 상태 추정기의 성과를 보기 위해, 다른 상태 추정기와의 비교가 수행 될 것이다. 본 논문의 시뮬레이션 결과는 제안된 상태 추정기가 DC 마이크로그리드의 상태 값을 개선할 수 있음을 보여준다. 정확도 증가 외에도, 심층 학습 기반 상태 추정기는 또한 기존 상태 추정기와 비교했을 때 더 빠른 계산 시간을 제공한다.
7745.abstract_en: The development of state estimators for local electrical energy supplying systems is inevitable as the role of the system’s becomes more important, especially with the recent increased interest in DC microgrids. For proper control and monitoring, it requires a state estimator that can adapt to the new technologies for DC microgrids. This paper mainly deals with DC microgrid’s state estimation based on a modified long short-term memory (LSTM) network with the weighted least square (WLS) loss function, used for the conventional state estimators. To obtain the performance of the proposed state estimator, also, a comparison study was done with other state estimation methods and it is included in this paper. The results show that the proposed state estimator can improve the performance in estimating states for DC microgrids. Other than the enhanced accuracy, the deep learning based state estimator can also provide faster computation speed than the conventional state estimator.
